note: Registry data could not be verified: DuckDuckGo search backend was down (connection refused) and Bing returned irrelevant results; Zauba Corp, TheCompanyCheck and Google all blocked automated access (403/429). Only the company's own website (francoindian.com) was readable: it confirms the entity exists and operates as 'Franco-Indian Pharmaceuticals Pvt. Ltd. (FIPPL)', founded 1949, headquartered in Mumbai, with own manufacturing facilities, R&D and QC labs, ~2000 employees, 23 C&F agents and ~1600 distributors, and exports of formulations to Asia/Africa plus UK, France and USA. That supports role = manufacturer (own plants, own brands such as Dexorange, Glyciphage, Grilinctus). CIN, PAN, GSTIN, incorporation date, GST status and MCA status are all null because no public registry page could be retrieved — these must be re-checked manually on mca.gov.in / GST portal. No basis for rejection: the entity demonstrably exists and there is no evidence of strike-off, liquidation or bankruptcy. Note on input: industry_claimed 'Нефтегаз и химия' (oil & gas / chemicals) is a misclassification — the company is a pharmaceutical formulator; declared HS 300490 is consistent with its actual activity. Revenue FY25/FY26: null, not public in accessible sources.
